summary.zh-CN: 一位老年男性胸痛数小时仍未缓解：读懂到院心电图，决定行动有多快，再沿着他的实际病程复盘。
summary.en: An older man arrives with hours of unrelieved chest pain: read his arrival ECG, decide how fast to act, then follow his recorded course.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 根据心电图报告区分右束支传导阻滞时的原发性与继发性 ST–T 改变：识别 V1–V3 导联 ST 段抬高伴直立 T 波为急性损伤，而不是阻滞本身的复极改变（第四版心肌梗死通用定义，2018）。
learningOutcomes.en: From a reported ECG, distinguish primary from secondary ST–T change in right bundle branch block, recognising ST elevation with upright T waves in V1–V3 as acute injury rather than the block's own repolarisation (Fourth Universal Definition of MI, 2018).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对持续缺血性胸痛伴 RBBB 下 ST 段抬高的患者立即启动直接 PCI 策略，不因等待肌钙蛋白、既往心电图或冠状动脉 CT 而延误（ESC 2023 ACS）。
learningOutcomes.en: Start a primary PCI strategy at once for ongoing ischaemic pain with ST elevation in RBBB, without waiting for troponin, an old ECG or a coronary CT (ESC 2023 ACS).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 给予疑似急性冠脉闭塞的即刻处理——持续心电监护并备除颤、阿司匹林 150–300 mg 负荷、PCI 时普通肝素 70–100 U/kg、仅在 SpO₂ < 90% 时吸氧——并说明为何能在 120 分钟内行直接 PCI 时不选溶栓（ESC 2023 ACS）。
learningOutcomes.en: Give the immediate care for suspected acute coronary occlusion — continuous ECG monitoring with a defibrillator, aspirin 150–300 mg, unfractionated heparin 70–100 U/kg at PCI, oxygen only if SpO₂ is below 90 % — and explain why fibrinolysis is not chosen when primary PCI is possible within 120 minutes (ESC 2023 ACS).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 解读连续心电图的演变（ST 段抬高范围扩大、T 波倒置、新出现的 QS 波）和反复胸痛等极高危表现，说明为何冠状动脉 CT 的狭窄分级或 Q 波都不能成为推迟有创造影的理由（ESC 2023 ACS）。
learningOutcomes.en: Interpret serial ECG evolution (spreading ST elevation, T-wave inversion, new QS complexes) and recurrent pain as very-high-risk features, and explain why neither a CT stenosis grade nor Q waves justify delaying invasive angiography (ESC 2023 ACS).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 为大面积前壁梗死后的患者制订出院前计划：住院期间超声心动图、12 个月双联抗血小板、LDL-C < 1.4 mmol/L 的降脂目标，并说明单纯持续的 RBBB 不需要起搏器（ESC 2023 ACS；ESC 2021 起搏指南）。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan discharge after a large anterior infarct — in-hospital echocardiography, 12 months of dual antiplatelet therapy, an LDL-C target below 1.4 mmol/L — and explain why isolated persisting RBBB needs no pacemaker (ESC 2023 ACS; ESC 2021 pacing).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说明缺少基线心电图时为何不能断定 RBBB 为新发，以及单个病例为何无法衡量延误造成的心肌损失。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why, without a baseline ECG, the RBBB cannot be called new, and why a single case cannot measure the myocardium lost to delay.

Every patient fact in this version (1.1.0) is one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0 — a 68-year-old man with five hours of chest pain and chest tightness; the first ECG and the repeat ECGs two hours later and after; cardiac markers (no values); the coronary CT; emergency angiography with a stent after the symptoms recurred; the ECG one week after the procedure — and none has yet been checked against the full article. The phases, decisions, intervention options, scoring, staff and the patient's voiced worry (a teaching device that adds no clinical fact) are teaching design; what is not recorded (vital signs, examination, ECG measurements, marker values, past history, echocardiography, long-term outcome) stays unknown. The report's figures (ECG tracings and imaging) and its PDF carry dates or identifiers and are withheld, so the case teaches from the written reports. text.zh-CN: 记录的病程：68岁男性，胸痛 5 小时伴胸闷就诊。首份心电图为右束支传导阻滞，V2–V3 导联 ST 段非弓背向上抬高、T 波直立，V4–V6 导联呈 Rs 型；医生多次复查心电图：2 小时后 V1–V3 导联 ST 段抬高、V2 导联 T 波倒置，此后 V4 导联呈 QS 型，V2–V3 与 V5–V6 导联 R 波降低，并随症状加重继续演变。cTnT 和 CK-MB 明显升高。冠状动脉 CT 示前降支近段中重度狭窄、回旋支中段轻中度狭窄。后来胸闷加重、胸痛反复，行急诊冠状动脉造影，见前降支近段次全闭塞，置入支架。术后 1 周心电图仍为右束支传导阻滞，V2–V4 导联呈 QS 型、V5 导联呈 rS 型，报告称为广泛梗死图形。本病例没有记录超声心动图、出院用药、随访和远期结局。
text.en: Recorded course: a 68-year-old man presented with five hours of chest pain and chest tightness. The first ECG showed RBBB with non-convex ST elevation and upright T waves in V2–V3 and Rs complexes in V4–V6. The ECG was repeated several times: two hours later there was ST elevation in V1–V3 with T-wave inversion in V2; later V4 became QS and the R waves fell in V2–V3 and V5–V6, evolving further as his symptoms worsened. Troponin T and CK-MB were markedly raised. A coronary CT showed moderate-to-severe proximal LAD and mild-to-moderate mid-circumflex stenosis. When the tightness worsened and the pain recurred, emergency coronary angiography showed a subtotal occlusion of the proximal LAD, which was stented. One week after the procedure the ECG still showed RBBB, with QS complexes in V2–V4 and an rS complex in V5, which the report calls an extensive infarction pattern. This case records no echocardiogram, discharge medicines, follow-up or long-term outcome.

dose.zh-CN: 床旁监护仪持续监测心电（同时测血压和经皮血氧饱和度），除颤仪推到床旁并贴好电极片。
dose.en: Continuous ECG on the bedside monitor (with blood pressure and SpO₂), the defibrillator at the bedside with pads applied.

name.zh-CN: P2Y12 受体抑制剂负荷量

dose.zh-CN: 替格瑞洛 180 mg 口服负荷（或普拉格雷 60 mg，有卒中或短暂性脑缺血发作史者禁用）；最迟在 PCI 时给予，造影前预先给药为可选。
dose.en: Ticagrelor 180 mg orally as a loading dose (or prasugrel 60 mg, not after a stroke or TIA); give it at the latest at PCI — loading before angiography is optional.

response.zh-CN: 已给负荷量。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。

name.zh-CN: 普通肝素静脉推注（PCI 抗凝）
name.en: Unfractionated heparin IV bolus (anticoagulation for PCI)

dose.zh-CN: 普通肝素 70–100 U/kg 静脉推注（计划使用糖蛋白 IIb/IIIa 受体拮抗剂时 50–70 U/kg），导管室内按活化凝血时间追加。
dose.en: Unfractionated heparin 70–100 U/kg IV bolus (50–70 U/kg if a glycoprotein IIb/IIIa inhibitor is planned), with further doses guided by the activated clotting time in the catheter laboratory.

response.zh-CN: 肝素已推注。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Heparin given. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 启动心导管室（急诊冠状动脉造影）
name.en: Activate the catheter laboratory (emergency coronary angiography)

dose.zh-CN: 一键启动：呼叫介入心内科医生和导管室团队，准备立即冠状动脉造影并按需行 PCI。
dose.en: Single-call activation: page the interventional cardiologist and the catheter-laboratory team for immediate coronary angiography and PCI as needed.

response.zh-CN: 介入团队已接到呼叫，导管室正在准备。本病例没有记录从首份心电图到进入导管室的时间；接下来的记录按实际病程展开。
response.en: The interventional team has been called and the catheter laboratory is being prepared. This case does not record the time from the first ECG to the catheter laboratory; the records that follow show the course as it happened.

dose.zh-CN: 硝酸甘油 0.4–0.5 mg 舌下含服，可每 5 分钟重复，最多 3 次；仅在收缩压 ≥ 90 mmHg、无右心室梗死、24–48 小时内未用磷酸二酯酶-5 抑制剂时使用。
dose.en: GTN 0.4–0.5 mg sublingually, repeated every 5 minutes up to 3 doses, only if the systolic blood pressure is at least 90 mmHg, there is no right-ventricular infarction and no PDE-5 inhibitor has been taken in the last 24–48 hours.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录血压，也没有记录是否用过硝酸酯；不模拟其效果。硝酸酯只缓解症状，不能开通闭塞的血管，也不能代替再灌注。
response.en: This case records no blood pressure and does not record whether a nitrate was given; it does not simulate its effect. A nitrate relieves symptoms — it does not open an occluded artery or replace reperfusion.

dose.zh-CN: 先测经皮血氧饱和度：SpO₂ < 90% 时经鼻导管给氧，滴定至 ≥ 90%；SpO₂ ≥ 90% 时不常规给氧。
dose.en: Measure the SpO₂ first: oxygen by nasal cannula only if it is below 90 %, titrated to at least 90 %; no routine oxygen at 90 % or above.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录他的血氧饱和度，也没有记录是否吸氧；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record his oxygen saturation or whether oxygen was given; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 替奈普酶按体重分档单次静脉推注（< 60 kg 30 mg，至 ≥ 90 kg 50 mg）。
dose.en: Tenecteplase as a single weight-banded IV bolus (30 mg below 60 kg, up to 50 mg at 90 kg or more).

harm.zh-CN: 在能于诊断后 120 分钟内完成直接 PCI 的医院（本院设有心导管室），直接 PCI 优于溶栓（ESC 2023 ACS）；溶栓只用于无法及时行 PCI 的情况。他的出血史、近期手术和卒中史都还不清楚，此时溶栓只增加出血风险。
harm.en: Where primary PCI can be done within 120 minutes of diagnosis — this hospital has a catheter laboratory — it is preferred to fibrinolysis (ESC 2023 ACS); fibrinolysis is for when timely PCI is not possible. With his bleeding, surgical and stroke history still unknown, it adds bleeding risk for no gain.

response.zh-CN: 溶栓药已推注。本病例没有记录溶栓，不模拟其效果。
response.en: The lytic has been given. This case records no fibrinolysis and does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 先做冠状动脉 CT 血管成像，再决定是否造影
name.en: CT coronary angiogram first; decide on catheterisation afterwards

dose.zh-CN: 送 CT 室行冠状动脉 CT 血管成像，按狭窄程度再决定是否行有创造影。
dose.en: Send him to the CT suite for a CT coronary angiogram and decide on invasive angiography by the degree of stenosis.

harm.zh-CN: ESC 2023 ACS 把冠状动脉 CT 血管成像用于肌钙蛋白和心电图正常或不确定、胸痛不再发作的疑似 ACS 患者，用来排除诊断；对胸痛持续、ST 段抬高的患者，它让患者离开有监护和除颤条件的抢救区，增加造影剂负担，并推迟本身就能诊断和治疗的有创造影。
harm.en: ESC 2023 ACS uses CT coronary angiography in suspected ACS when troponin and the ECG are normal or inconclusive and the pain has not recurred — to rule the diagnosis out. With ongoing pain and ST elevation it takes him away from monitoring and a defibrillator, adds contrast and delays the invasive angiogram that both diagnoses and treats.

response.zh-CN: 已预约 CT。他的病历中也有一份冠状动脉 CT 报告，在下一阶段展示（做 CT 的时间没有记录）。
response.en: The CT is booked. His record also holds a coronary CT report, shown in the next part of the case (when that CT was done is not recorded).

name.zh-CN: 收入病房药物治疗，24 小时内择期造影
name.en: Admit for medical therapy with angiography within 24 hours

dose.zh-CN: 收入心内科病房或 CCU，给予抗栓和抗缺血治疗，复查肌钙蛋白和心电图，24 小时内安排冠状动脉造影。
dose.en: Admit to the cardiology ward or CCU on antithrombotic and anti-ischaemic treatment, repeat the troponin and ECGs, and schedule coronary angiography within 24 hours.

harm.zh-CN: 24 小时内的早期侵入策略针对病情稳定的高危非 ST 段抬高 ACS。胸痛持续伴 RBBB 下的 ST 段抬高要按直接 PCI 策略处理；即便按非 ST 段抬高 ACS 理解，持续或反复胸痛伴动态 ST 段改变也属于极高危，需要 2 小时内的立即侵入策略（ESC 2023 ACS）。
harm.en: An early invasive strategy within 24 hours is for stable high-risk NSTE-ACS. Ongoing pain with ST elevation in RBBB calls for a primary PCI strategy; even read as NSTE-ACS, ongoing or recurrent pain with dynamic ST changes is very high risk and needs an immediate invasive strategy within 2 hours (ESC 2023 ACS).

response.zh-CN: 已安排收入院。本病例不模拟这一选择之后的经过；接下来的记录按实际病程展开。
response.en: Admission arranged. This case does not simulate what would follow; the records that follow show the course as it happened.

dose.zh-CN: 请电生理医生评估并植入永久起搏器。
dose.en: Ask the electrophysiology team to assess him for a permanent pacemaker.

harm.zh-CN: 单纯的右束支传导阻滞（不伴高度房室传导阻滞，也没有不明原因晕厥）不是永久起搏的指征（ESC 2021 心脏起搏指南）；本病例 1 周心电图只记录了 RBBB 和梗死图形。梗死后的传导问题要观察和复查，而不是因为束支阻滞本身植入起搏器。
harm.en: Isolated RBBB without high-degree AV block or unexplained syncope is not an indication for permanent pacing (ESC 2021 cardiac pacing guideline); the one-week ECG here records RBBB and the infarction pattern only. Conduction after an infarct is watched and re-checked, not paced for the bundle branch block itself.

response.zh-CN: 转介已提出。本病例没有记录起搏评估，不模拟其结果。
response.en: Referral made. This case records no pacing assessment and does not simulate one.

name.zh-CN: 出院前二级预防与随访安排
name.en: Secondary prevention and follow-up before discharge

dose.zh-CN: 阿司匹林 75–100 mg 每日一次，加替格瑞洛 90 mg 每日两次（或普拉格雷 10 mg 每日一次），共 12 个月，出血风险高时调整；高强度他汀，LDL-C 目标 < 1.4 mmol/L 且较基线下降 ≥ 50%；按左心室射血分数使用 β 受体阻滞剂、ACEI/ARB 和醛固酮受体拮抗剂；转介心脏康复；射血分数降低者梗死后 6–12 周复查。
dose.en: Aspirin 75–100 mg daily plus ticagrelor 90 mg twice daily (or prasugrel 10 mg daily) for 12 months, adjusted if bleeding risk is high; a high-intensity statin to an LDL-C below 1.4 mmol/L and at least 50 % below baseline; a beta-blocker, ACE inhibitor or ARB and mineralocorticoid-receptor antagonist by LVEF; cardiac rehabilitation; LVEF re-assessed 6–12 weeks after the infarct if it is reduced.

response.zh-CN: 已列入出院计划。本病例没有记录出院用药、心脏康复或随访，不模拟其效果。
response.en: Added to the discharge plan. This case does not record his discharge medicines, rehabilitation or follow-up and does not simulate their effect.

hint.zh-CN: 要判断有多紧急，你需要知道这次胸痛的哪些情况？现在还在痛吗？
hint.en: Before you can judge how urgent this is, what do you need to know about the pain — and is it still there?

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁问他胸痛何时开始、现在是否仍在痛、还有什么不舒服。
guidance.en: At the bedside, ask when the pain began, whether it is still there and what else he feels.

title.zh-CN: 记录并解读到院心电图
title.en: Record and read the arrival ECG

hint.zh-CN: 按顺序读图：节律、QRS 波，再看 ST 段和 T 波。哪些改变可以用 QRS 波本身的形态来解释，哪些不能？有没有可以对比的旧心电图？
hint.en: Read it in order: rhythm, the QRS, then the ST segments and T waves. Which changes can the QRS pattern itself explain, and which can it not? Is there an old tracing to compare?

guidance.zh-CN: 推来心电图机记录 12 导联心电图，在床旁或病历终端阅读，并查找既往心电图；然后到会诊板作答决策 1。
guidance.en: Bring the ECG machine and record a 12-lead ECG, read it at the bedside or a records terminal, look for an earlier tracing, then answer decision 1 on the case board.

hint.zh-CN: 他还在痛：这份心电图需要你等待什么结果才能行动吗？哪种处理能最快、最可靠地解决问题？在此期间他床边要准备什么？
hint.en: He is still in pain: does this tracing make you wait for any result before acting? Which treatment solves the problem fastest and most reliably — and what must be at his bedside meanwhile?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板作答决策 2，再把计划付诸行动：床旁的监护和用药，以及启动你所选再灌注方案的那一步（呼叫或医嘱）。行动之后，病例才进入记录病程。
guidance.en: Answer decision 2 on the case board, then put your plan into action: monitoring and medicines at the bedside, and the call or order that starts your reperfusion plan. The recorded course opens once you have acted.

title.zh-CN: 回顾到院后的记录病程
title.en: Review the recorded hours after arrival

hint.zh-CN: 把每一份新心电图和第一份比较：哪些导联变了、朝哪个方向变？标志物又补充了什么？CT 的狭窄分级能告诉你斑块此刻是否稳定吗？
hint.en: Compare each new tracing with the first: which leads have changed, and which way? What do the markers add? Can a CT stenosis grade tell you whether a plaque is stable right now?

guidance.zh-CN: 问他现在怎么样，复查心电图，调阅心肌损伤标志物和冠状动脉 CT 报告，然后作答决策 3。
guidance.en: Ask how he is now, repeat the ECG, read the cardiac markers and the coronary CT report, then answer decision 3.

hint.zh-CN: 出院前，他还需要哪项心肌评估？哪些药要用多久、目标是多少？之后的心电图上，有没有哪项表现真正需要植入装置？
hint.en: Before he goes home, which assessment of the heart muscle does he need? Which medicines, for how long and to what targets — and does anything on the later tracing truly need a device?

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅心导管室记录，复查 1 周后的心电图，然后作答决策 4 并安排出院计划。
guidance.en: Read the catheter laboratory record and the ECG a week later, then answer decision 4 and set out the discharge plan.

hint.zh-CN: 记录的病程与你的计划有哪些不同？哪些情况始终没有记录？
hint.en: Where does the recorded course differ from your plan, and what was never recorded?

guidance.zh-CN: 在病历终端调阅记录的病程与结局。
guidance.en: Read the recorded course and outcome at a records terminal.

prompt.zh-CN: 他胸痛 5 小时仍未缓解。首份心电图：右束支传导阻滞；V2–V3 导联 ST 段抬高，形态非弓背向上，T 波直立；V4–V6 导联呈 Rs 型。没有可供对比的既往心电图。你怎样解读这些 ST–T 改变？
prompt.en: Five hours into chest pain that has not eased. His first ECG shows right bundle branch block; ST elevation in V2–V3, not convex, with upright T waves; and Rs complexes in V4–V6. There is no earlier ECG for comparison. How do you read these ST–T changes?

need.zh-CN: 先问清胸痛何时开始、现在是否仍在痛，记录并阅读到院心电图，并查找既往心电图。
need.en: First establish when the pain began and whether it is still there, record and read the arrival ECG, and look for an earlier tracing.

text.zh-CN: 原发性 ST–T 改变：V2–V3 导联 ST 段抬高、T 波直立，与终末 R′ 波同向——结合持续胸痛，按急性前壁损伤处理
text.en: A primary ST–T change: the ST elevation and upright T waves in V2–V3 point the same way as the terminal R′ — with his pain still going on, treat it as acute anterior injury

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。右束支传导阻滞的继发性复极改变与终末 R′ 波方向相反（V1–V3 导联 ST 段压低、T 波倒置）；与之同向的 ST 段抬高和直立 T 波属于原发性改变。第四版心肌梗死通用定义（ESC/ACC/AHA/WHF 2018）指出，RBBB 患者出现新的 ST 段抬高或 Q 波应考虑心肌缺血或梗死；ESC 2023 ACS 指南对持续缺血症状合并束支阻滞的患者采用直接 PCI 策略。
feedback.en: Correct. The secondary repolarisation of RBBB runs opposite to the terminal R′ (ST depression and T-wave inversion in V1–V3); ST elevation and upright T waves in the same direction as the R′ are primary changes. The Fourth Universal Definition of MI (ESC/ACC/AHA/WHF 2018) says new ST elevation or Q waves in RBBB should raise ischaemia or infarction, and ESC 2023 ACS manages ongoing ischaemic symptoms with bundle branch block by a primary PCI strategy.

text.zh-CN: RBBB 的继发性复极改变：束支阻滞会让 V1–V3 导联的 ST 段和 T 波变形，这类改变在 RBBB 患者中很常见，本身没有缺血意义，继续观察、稍后再复查一次心电图即可
text.en: Secondary repolarisation of RBBB: the block distorts the ST segment and T wave in V1–V3, changes that are common in RBBB and carry no ischaemic meaning of their own, so watching him and repeating the ECG later is enough

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。RBBB 的继发改变方向是确定的：V1–V3 导联 ST 段压低、T 波倒置。ST 段抬高伴直立 T 波恰恰方向相反，不能归因于阻滞（第四版心肌梗死通用定义，2018）。把它当作“阻滞造成的变形”，正是这类患者被延误的常见原因。
feedback.en: No. The secondary change of RBBB has a fixed direction: ST depression and T-wave inversion in V1–V3. ST elevation with upright T waves runs the other way and cannot be blamed on the block (Fourth Universal Definition of MI, 2018). Calling it 'block artefact' is the classic route to delay in patients like him.

text.zh-CN: 良性早复极样改变：ST 段抬高不呈弓背向上，形态不像心肌梗死，而且 V4–V6 导联仍保留 Rs 型 R 波，不支持大面积梗死
text.en: A benign early-repolarisation pattern: the ST elevation is not convex, its shape is not that of an infarct, and the Rs complexes in V4–V6 keep their R waves, which argues against a large infarct

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。ST 段形态不能排除急性冠脉闭塞：早期前壁梗死的 ST 段抬高常呈直线或凹面向上，伴直立的 T 波；R 波尚存也只说明坏死还没有形成，不说明没有损伤。在 RBBB 背景下，V2–V3 导联出现与终末 R′ 同向的 ST 段抬高本身就不是良性表现（第四版心肌梗死通用定义，2018）。
feedback.en: No. ST morphology does not exclude acute coronary occlusion: early anterior infarction often shows straight or concave ST elevation with upright T waves, and preserved R waves mean necrosis has not yet formed, not that there is no injury. In RBBB, ST elevation concordant with the terminal R′ in V2–V3 is not a benign finding (Fourth Universal Definition of MI, 2018).

text.zh-CN: 暂时无法判断：只有拿到既往心电图、确认 RBBB 是新发的，才能解读 ST 段；在此之前应等待肌钙蛋白结果来决定下一步
text.en: Not interpretable yet: the ST segment can only be read once an earlier ECG shows whether the RBBB is new, and until then the troponin result should decide the next step

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。RBBB 并不妨碍判读 ST 段，阻滞是否新发也不改变当下的处理：ESC 2023 ACS 对持续缺血症状合并束支阻滞的患者采用直接 PCI 策略，疑似 ST 段抬高心肌梗死时再灌注决策不等待肌钙蛋白。缺少旧心电图只意味着无法证明阻滞是新发的。
feedback.en: No. RBBB does not stop you reading the ST segment, and whether the block is new does not change what to do now: ESC 2023 ACS manages ongoing ischaemic symptoms with bundle branch block by a primary PCI strategy, and the reperfusion decision in suspected STEMI does not wait for troponin. A missing old ECG only means you cannot prove the block is new.

text.zh-CN: RBBB 本身即可确诊：新出现的右束支传导阻滞等同于前降支闭塞，无需再分析 ST 段和 T 波，可直接诊断急性前壁心肌梗死
text.en: The RBBB itself is diagnostic: a new right bundle branch block equals LAD occlusion, so there is no need to analyse the ST segment or T waves before calling this an acute anterior infarct

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。RBBB 本身不是诊断标准，而且没有旧心电图，无法知道它是不是新发的。真正提示急性损伤的是 V2–V3 导联与终末 R′ 同向的 ST 段抬高和直立 T 波；RBBB 合并急性心肌梗死提示梗死范围大、预后差，但诊断仍要依靠 ST–T 改变和临床表现（第四版心肌梗死通用定义，2018）。
feedback.en: No. RBBB is not a diagnostic criterion in itself, and with no earlier ECG you cannot know it is new. What signals acute injury is the ST elevation with upright T waves concordant with the terminal R′ in V2–V3; RBBB with an acute infarct marks a large territory and a worse prognosis, but the diagnosis still rests on the ST–T changes and the clinical picture (Fourth Universal Definition of MI, 2018).

prompt.zh-CN: 你判断这是 RBBB 背景下的急性前壁损伤，他仍在胸痛。本院设有心导管室。现在的处理计划是什么？
prompt.en: You have read the tracing as acute anterior injury despite the RBBB, and he is still in pain. This hospital has a catheter laboratory. What is your plan now?

need.zh-CN: 先完成到院心电图的解读（决策 1）。
need.en: First commit to a reading of the arrival ECG (decision 1).

text.zh-CN: 立即启动导管室行急诊造影和直接 PCI：阿司匹林 150–300 mg 嚼服，PCI 时普通肝素 70–100 U/kg，心电监护并备除颤，不等肌钙蛋白
text.en: Activate the catheter laboratory now for angiography and primary PCI: aspirin 150–300 mg chewed, unfractionated heparin 70–100 U/kg at PCI, ECG monitoring with a defibrillator, no wait for troponin

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。持续缺血症状伴 RBBB 下的 ST 段抬高按直接 PCI 策略处理：能在诊断后 120 分钟内完成 PCI 时，直接 PCI 优于溶栓，并应尽快持续心电监护、具备除颤条件（ESC 2023 ACS）。中国 STEMI 指南（2019）同样推荐阿司匹林 150–300 mg 负荷，且不因等待心肌损伤标志物而延误再灌注。
feedback.en: Correct. Ongoing ischaemic symptoms with ST elevation in RBBB are managed by a primary PCI strategy: primary PCI is preferred to fibrinolysis when it can be done within 120 minutes of diagnosis, with continuous ECG monitoring and defibrillation available as soon as possible (ESC 2023 ACS). The Chinese STEMI guideline (2019) likewise loads aspirin 150–300 mg and does not hold reperfusion for cardiac markers.

text.zh-CN: 先做冠状动脉 CT 血管成像明确解剖：见到前降支严重狭窄或闭塞再启动导管室，其间给阿司匹林和抗凝并持续监护，这样冠脉若无明显病变，就免去了一次有创检查
text.en: A CT coronary angiogram first to define the anatomy: activate the catheter laboratory if it shows a severe LAD stenosis or occlusion, with aspirin, anticoagulation and monitoring meanwhile, so that clean coronaries spare him an invasive test

feedback.zh-CN: 不对，尽管这位患者的病历中确有一份冠状动脉 CT 报告。ESC 2023 ACS 把冠状动脉 CT 血管成像用于肌钙蛋白和心电图正常或不确定、胸痛不再发作的疑似 ACS 患者，用来排除诊断；对持续胸痛和 ST 段抬高的患者，它让患者离开监护区，并推迟本身就能诊断和治疗的有创造影。
feedback.en: No — though this patient's record does include a coronary CT report. ESC 2023 ACS uses CT coronary angiography in suspected ACS when troponin and the ECG are normal or inconclusive and the pain has not recurred, to rule the diagnosis out. With ongoing pain and ST elevation it takes him away from monitoring and delays the invasive angiogram that both diagnoses and treats.

text.zh-CN: 先按 0 小时/1 小时高敏肌钙蛋白方案采血，15–30 分钟后复查心电图；肌钙蛋白升高或 ST 段抬高加重时再启动导管室
text.en: Run the 0 h/1 h high-sensitivity troponin protocol and repeat the ECG in 15–30 minutes, activating the catheter laboratory if the troponin rises or the ST elevation grows

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。0 小时/1 小时肌钙蛋白方案用于心电图不能诊断时排除或确诊非 ST 段抬高心肌梗死；ESC 2023 ACS 不让持续胸痛伴 ST 段抬高的患者等待肌钙蛋白。复查心电图是对的，但应与启动导管室同时进行，而不是作为启动的前提。
feedback.en: No. The 0 h/1 h troponin algorithm rules NSTEMI in or out when the ECG is not diagnostic; ESC 2023 ACS does not make a patient with ongoing pain and ST elevation wait for troponin. Repeating the ECG is right — alongside activation, not as its precondition.

text.zh-CN: 立即替奈普酶溶栓：症状 5 小时、仍在 12 小时时间窗之内，溶栓药几分钟内就能推注完毕，比等待导管室团队集结、穿刺和送入导丝更快开通血管
text.en: Tenecteplase now: five hours from onset is well inside the 12-hour window, and a lytic can be given within minutes, opening the artery sooner than waiting for the catheter team to assemble

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。溶栓用于预计无法在诊断后 120 分钟内完成直接 PCI 的情况（ESC 2023 ACS）；本院有心导管室，直接 PCI 更有效、出血风险更低。何况他的出血史、近期手术和卒中史都还没有问清。
feedback.en: No. Fibrinolysis is for when primary PCI cannot be done within 120 minutes of diagnosis (ESC 2023 ACS); with a catheter laboratory here, primary PCI is more effective and carries less bleeding risk — and his bleeding, surgical and stroke history has not even been established.

text.zh-CN: 收入 CCU，给予双联抗血小板、抗凝和抗缺血治疗，按高危非 ST 段抬高 ACS 在 24 小时内行冠状动脉造影
text.en: Admit to the CCU on dual antiplatelet therapy, anticoagulation and anti-ischaemic treatment, with coronary angiography within 24 hours as for high-risk NSTE-ACS

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。24 小时内的早期侵入策略针对病情稳定的高危非 ST 段抬高 ACS。持续胸痛伴 ST 段抬高要按直接 PCI 策略处理；即便按非 ST 段抬高 ACS 理解，持续或反复胸痛伴动态 ST 段改变也属于极高危，需要 2 小时内立即侵入策略（ESC 2023 ACS）。
feedback.en: No. An early invasive strategy within 24 hours is for stable high-risk NSTE-ACS. Ongoing pain with ST elevation calls for a primary PCI strategy, and even read as NSTE-ACS, ongoing or recurrent pain with dynamic ST changes is very high risk and needs an immediate invasive strategy within 2 hours (ESC 2023 ACS).

prompt.zh-CN: 记录病程：2 小时后复查心电图示 V1–V3 导联 ST 段抬高、V2 导联 T 波倒置；此后 V4 导联呈 QS 型，V2–V3 与 V5–V6 导联 R 波降低，并随症状加重继续演变。cTnT 和 CK-MB 明显升高。冠状动脉 CT 报告前降支近段中重度狭窄、回旋支中段轻中度狭窄。他说胸口越来越闷，胸痛一阵阵又来。他还没有做有创造影。这些资料对下一步意味着什么？
prompt.en: The recorded course: two hours later the ECG shows ST elevation in V1–V3 with T-wave inversion in V2; later V4 becomes QS and the R waves fall in V2–V3 and V5–V6, evolving further as his symptoms worsen. Troponin T and CK-MB are markedly raised. The coronary CT reports moderate-to-severe proximal LAD and mild-to-moderate mid-circumflex stenosis. He says the tightness is getting worse and the pain keeps coming back. He has not yet had invasive angiography. What do these findings mean for the next step?

need.zh-CN: 先在本阶段问他现在感觉怎样，并复查心电图、调阅心肌损伤标志物和冠状动脉 CT 报告。
need.en: First ask how he is now, and repeat the ECG and read the cardiac markers and the coronary CT report in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 胸痛反复、ST 段抬高扩展到 V1–V3，说明前壁梗死仍在进展：立即行有创冠状动脉造影，并对罪犯血管行 PCI
text.en: Recurrent pain with ST elevation now spreading to V1–V3 shows an anterior infarct still in progress: immediate invasive coronary angiography and PCI of the culprit artery

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。反复或持续胸痛加上动态 ST 段改变是 2 小时内立即侵入策略的极高危指征；缺血症状持续时，即使超过 12 小时也推荐直接 PCI 策略（ESC 2023 ACS）。记录中的急诊造影是在症状反复之后才做的，发现前降支近段次全闭塞并置入支架。
feedback.en: Correct. Recurrent or ongoing pain with dynamic ST changes is a very-high-risk indication for an immediate invasive strategy within 2 hours, and with ongoing ischaemic symptoms a primary PCI strategy is recommended even beyond 12 hours (ESC 2023 ACS). In the record, the emergency angiogram came only after the pain recurred and found a subtotal occlusion of the proximal LAD, which was stented.

text.zh-CN: CT 显示的是狭窄而不是闭塞：继续双联抗血小板、抗凝和硝酸酯治疗，收入病房复查肌钙蛋白，等病情平稳后再择期造影，只有胸痛用药也控制不住时才提前做冠状动脉造影
text.en: The CT shows a stenosis, not an occlusion: continue dual antiplatelet therapy, anticoagulation and nitrates, admit him to repeat the troponin, and plan elective angiography once he settles, sooner only if the pain cannot be controlled

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。CT 的狭窄分级描述的是管腔形态，判断不了斑块是否破裂、有没有血栓正在形成；他胸痛反复、ST 段持续抬高并出现 QS 波，已属于极高危，需要立即侵入策略（ESC 2023 ACS）。等症状再发才造影，正是记录病程中的延误。
feedback.en: No. A CT stenosis grade describes the lumen, not whether the plaque has ruptured or thrombus is forming; recurrent pain with persisting ST elevation and new QS waves is very high risk and needs an immediate invasive strategy (ESC 2023 ACS). Waiting for the pain to come back before angiography is the delay the recorded course shows.

text.zh-CN: V2 导联 T 波倒置说明血管已经自发再通，紧迫性已过：继续抗栓治疗，按非 ST 段抬高 ACS 在 24 小时内造影即可
text.en: The T-wave inversion in V2 shows the artery has reopened by itself, so the urgency has passed: continue antithrombotic treatment and arrange angiography within 24 hours as for NSTE-ACS

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。T 波倒置可见于再灌注，但前提是胸痛消失、ST 段回落；他的 ST 段抬高扩展到 V1–V3，随后出现 QS 波，胸痛还在反复，说明梗死仍在进展。ESC 2023 ACS 对反复胸痛伴动态 ST 段改变要求 2 小时内立即侵入策略。
feedback.en: No. T-wave inversion can follow reperfusion, but only with resolution of the pain and of the ST elevation; here the ST elevation has spread to V1–V3, QS waves have followed and the pain keeps returning — the infarct is still evolving. ESC 2023 ACS requires an immediate invasive strategy within 2 hours for recurrent pain with dynamic ST changes.

text.zh-CN: V4 导联 QS 型和 R 波降低说明前壁梗死已经完成：再灌注已经没有心肌可以挽救，应收入病房以药物治疗为主，择期再评估血运重建
text.en: QS in V4 and the falling R waves show the anterior infarct is complete: there is no myocardium left for reperfusion to save, so treat him medically on the ward and assess revascularisation electively

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。Q 波说明已有心肌坏死，不说明已无存活心肌；缺血症状持续或反复，提示仍有心肌处于危险之中。ESC 2023 ACS 对就诊超过 12 小时、但缺血症状持续的患者仍推荐直接 PCI 策略，Q 波本身不是放弃再灌注的理由。
feedback.en: No. Q waves mark necrosis, not the absence of viable myocardium; ongoing or recurrent ischaemic symptoms mean muscle is still at risk. ESC 2023 ACS recommends a primary PCI strategy even beyond 12 hours when ischaemic symptoms persist, and Q waves alone are no reason to withhold it.

text.zh-CN: CT 提示两支血管病变：应转心外科行冠状动脉旁路移植术，而不是对前降支做 PCI，以便一次完成全部血运重建
text.en: The CT shows two-vessel disease: refer for coronary artery bypass grafting rather than PCI of the LAD, so that revascularisation is completed in one operation

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。急性梗死伴持续缺血时，首要任务是尽快开通罪犯血管，通常靠 PCI；回旋支只是轻中度狭窄，是否需要处理在造影时评估。只有罪犯病变不适合 PCI 或出现心源性休克等并发症时，才由心脏团队考虑急诊旁路手术（ESC 2023 ACS）。
feedback.en: No. In an acute infarct with ongoing ischaemia the first task is to open the culprit artery quickly, usually by PCI; the circumflex lesion is only mild-to-moderate and is assessed at angiography. Emergency bypass is a Heart Team decision when the culprit lesion is unsuitable for PCI or in complications such as cardiogenic shock (ESC 2023 ACS).

prompt.zh-CN: 急诊造影示前降支近段次全闭塞，已置入支架。1 周后心电图仍为右束支传导阻滞，V2–V4 导联呈 QS 型，V5 导联呈 rS 型（广泛梗死图形）。出院前计划应包括哪些？（多选）
prompt.en: Emergency angiography showed a subtotal occlusion of the proximal LAD, now stented. A week later the ECG still shows RBBB, with QS complexes in V2–V4 and an rS complex in V5 (an extensive infarction pattern). What should the plan before discharge include? (Select all that apply.)

need.zh-CN: 先调阅心导管室记录，并复查 1 周后的心电图。
need.en: First read the catheter laboratory record and the ECG a week later.

text.zh-CN: 住院期间行经胸超声心动图，评估左心室射血分数、室壁运动和有无左心室血栓
text.en: Transthoracic echocardiography before discharge for LVEF, regional wall motion and LV thrombus

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。ESC 2023 ACS 建议所有 ACS 患者住院期间行超声心动图，评估整体和节段收缩功能、机械并发症并排除左心室血栓；广泛前壁梗死后尤其重要，射血分数还决定后续用药和猝死风险评估。
feedback.en: Include. ESC 2023 ACS recommends echocardiography during the admission in every ACS patient to assess global and regional function, look for mechanical complications and exclude LV thrombus — all the more after an extensive anterior infarct; the LVEF also steers drug therapy and the sudden-death risk assessment.

text.zh-CN: 双联抗血小板 12 个月：阿司匹林 75–100 mg 每日一次，加替格瑞洛 90 mg 每日两次或普拉格雷 10 mg 每日一次（无高出血风险时）
text.en: Dual antiplatelet therapy for 12 months: aspirin 75–100 mg daily plus ticagrelor 90 mg twice daily or prasugrel 10 mg daily, unless bleeding risk is high

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。ESC 2023 ACS 对无高出血风险的 ACS 患者默认 12 个月双联抗血小板，P2Y12 抑制剂首选普拉格雷或替格瑞洛；出血风险高时缩短疗程或降阶。本病例没有记录他实际的出院用药。
feedback.en: Include. ESC 2023 ACS makes 12 months of dual antiplatelet therapy with prasugrel or ticagrelor the default for ACS patients without high bleeding risk, shortening or de-escalating when bleeding risk is high. The case does not record his actual discharge medicines.

text.zh-CN: 尽早开始高强度他汀，目标 LDL-C < 1.4 mmol/L 且较基线下降 ≥ 50%，未达标时加用依折麦布
text.en: A high-intensity statin started early, aiming for LDL-C below 1.4 mmol/L and at least a 50 % fall from baseline, adding ezetimibe if the target is missed

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。ESC 2023 ACS 建议所有 ACS 患者尽早开始高强度他汀，目标 LDL-C < 1.4 mmol/L 且较基线下降 ≥ 50%，未达标时加用依折麦布，必要时再加 PCSK9 抑制剂。中国血脂管理指南（2023 年）按危险分层定目标：ASCVD 极高危者 LDL-C < 1.8 mmol/L，超高危者 < 1.4 mmol/L，均要求较基线降幅超过 50%；他的危险因素没有记录，无法判断属于哪一层。他的血脂也没有记录，但这不影响启动治疗。
feedback.en: Include. ESC 2023 ACS recommends a high-intensity statin as early as possible in every ACS patient, aiming for LDL-C below 1.4 mmol/L and at least a 50 % fall from baseline, adding ezetimibe and then a PCSK9 inhibitor if needed. The Chinese lipid guideline (2023) sets targets by risk tier — LDL-C below 1.8 mmol/L for very-high-risk and below 1.4 mmol/L for ultra-high-risk ASCVD, each with a fall of more than 50 % — and his tier cannot be set because his risk factors are not recorded. His lipids are not recorded either, which does not delay starting treatment.

text.zh-CN: 植入永久起搏器：梗死后 1 周 RBBB 仍然存在，提示传导系统受损，日后可能进展为完全性房室传导阻滞
text.en: A permanent pacemaker, because RBBB persisting a week after the infarct shows conduction-system damage that may progress to complete heart block

feedback.zh-CN: 不应选。单纯的束支阻滞（不伴高度房室传导阻滞或不明原因晕厥）不是永久起搏指征（ESC 2021 心脏起搏指南）；本病例 1 周心电图只记录了 RBBB 和梗死图形，没有记录房室传导阻滞。梗死后的传导异常应继续观察和复查。
feedback.en: Exclude. Isolated bundle branch block without high-degree AV block or unexplained syncope is not an indication for permanent pacing (ESC 2021 cardiac pacing guideline); the one-week ECG here records RBBB and the infarction pattern, not AV block. Conduction after the infarct is watched and re-checked.

text.zh-CN: 出院前植入 ICD 作一级预防：广泛前壁梗死后心脏性猝死风险高，不必等待复查射血分数
text.en: An ICD for primary prevention before discharge: sudden death is common after an extensive anterior infarct, so there is no need to wait for a repeat ejection fraction

feedback.zh-CN: 不应选。梗死后最初几周内常规植入 ICD 作一级预防没有降低总死亡率（DINAMIT、IRIS 试验）；ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南建议射血分数降低者在梗死后 6–12 周复查，再决定是否植入。他的射血分数还没有测量。
feedback.en: Exclude. Routine primary-prevention ICD implantation in the first weeks after an infarct has not reduced overall mortality (the DINAMIT and IRIS trials); ESC 2022 ventricular arrhythmia guidance re-assesses a reduced LVEF 6–12 weeks after the infarct before deciding. His LVEF has not even been measured.

text.zh-CN: 问清胸痛何时开始、到院时仍在痛，以及伴随的胸闷
text.en: Established when the pain began, that it was still present on arrival and that it came with chest tightness

text.zh-CN: 抗栓治疗前询问既往心脏病或心电图异常、出血/手术/卒中史、药物过敏和长期用药
text.en: Before antithrombotic treatment, asked about previous heart disease or ECG abnormality, bleeding, surgery or stroke, drug allergies and regular medicines

text.zh-CN: 到院即记录并阅读 12 导联心电图，并查找可对比的既往心电图
text.en: Recorded and read a 12-lead ECG on arrival and looked for an earlier tracing to compare

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即识别 RBBB 背景下 V2–V3 导联的原发性 ST–T 改变
text.en: Identified the primary ST–T change in V2–V3 despite the RBBB, at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择直接 PCI 策略，并实际启动了心导管室
text.en: Chose a primary PCI strategy at the first attempt and actually activated the catheter laboratory

text.zh-CN: 给予持续心电监护与除颤准备、阿司匹林负荷和 PCI 用普通肝素
text.en: Gave continuous ECG monitoring with a defibrillator ready, an aspirin loading dose and unfractionated heparin for PCI

text.zh-CN: 没有用冠状动脉 CT、收住院择期造影或溶栓代替立即造影
text.en: Did not replace immediate angiography with a coronary CT, admission for later angiography or fibrinolysis

text.zh-CN: 在记录病程中复查心电图，并调阅心肌损伤标志物和冠状动脉 CT 报告
text.en: In the recorded course, repeated the ECG and read the cardiac markers and the coronary CT report

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即判断进展中的前壁梗死需要立即造影，没有被 CT 狭窄分级、T 波倒置或 QS 波误导
text.en: Recognised at the first attempt that the evolving anterior infarct needed immediate angiography, unswayed by the CT grade, the T-wave inversion or the QS complexes

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即制订出院前计划，并申请超声心动图、安排二级预防
text.en: Set the pre-discharge plan correctly at the first attempt, requested echocardiography and arranged secondary prevention

text.zh-CN: 没有因单纯持续的 RBBB 转介植入起搏器
text.en: Did not refer him for a pacemaker for isolated persisting RBBB

text.zh-CN: 向他解释病情、紧急造影的理由与风险，并取得同意
text.en: Explained the problem, the reason for urgent angiography and its risks to him, and obtained his consent

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现（Calgary–Cambridge：开始接诊、解释与计划、结束）：自我介绍，先了解他对自己为什么来医院的理解；用通俗的话说明心电图提示心脏的一根血管很可能堵了——“束支传导阻滞”这种传导图形只是让心电图看起来不典型——最快的办法是立即做冠状动脉造影，多半需要放支架；说明抗血小板和抗凝药的作用与出血风险，并取得造影的知情同意；坦诚回应他“是不是心脏出了问题”的担心，不作虚假保证，也不承诺病例没有记录的结局；确认他听懂了，留出提问时间，告诉他接下来会发生什么。之后能解释为什么持续的束支阻滞本身不需要起搏器，以及超声心动图、12 个月的药物和心脏康复为什么重要。不编造病例中没有的检查结果。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (Calgary–Cambridge: initiating, explaining and planning, closing): introduces themselves and first finds out what he understands about why he is here; explains in plain words that the heart tracing suggests one of the heart's arteries is blocked — a wiring pattern called bundle branch block only makes the tracing look unusual — and that the fastest fix is an angiogram now, usually with a stent; explains the blood-thinning medicines and their bleeding risk and obtains consent for the procedure; answers his worry that it is his heart honestly, without false reassurance or promises about an outcome the case does not record; checks understanding, leaves room for questions and says what happens next. Later explains why the persisting bundle branch block does not by itself need a pacemaker and why the echo, the 12 months of tablets and rehabilitation matter. Invents no result the case does not record.

knowledge.zh-CN: 到院交班（ISBAR）：68岁男性，胸痛 5 小时仍未缓解，刚到急诊抢救区。抢救区床旁有监护除颤仪、心电图机、抢救车（留置针、常用急救药）和氧气；心导管室和介入医生可一键电话呼叫。病房有自己的心电图机、床旁监护仪、除颤仪和抢救车，护士站有病历终端；超声心动图机要从影像科推来。复述医嘱并完成护理范围内的操作；只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断。被问到生命体征、既往史或用药时，如实说没有可报的记录，绝不报出数字。
knowledge.en: Handover on arrival (ISBAR): a 68-year-old man with five hours of chest pain that has not eased, just arrived in the ED resus area. In resus, at the bedside: a monitor-defibrillator, the ECG machine, the crash cart (cannulas, emergency drugs) and oxygen; the catheter laboratory and the interventional cardiologist are reached with a single call. The ward has its own ECG machine, bedside monitors, defibrillator and crash cart, with a records terminal at the nurses' station; the echo machine has to be brought from imaging. Reads orders back and carries out nursing-scope tasks; reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses. Asked for vital signs, past history or medicines, says plainly there is nothing recorded to report — never gives a number.

name.zh-CN: 邝医生（急诊科主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教（PEARLS），只围绕学员已经拿到的资料提问，例如：“RBBB 本身会让 V1–V3 导联的 ST 段和 T 波朝哪个方向？”“ST 段不呈弓背向上，就能排除冠脉闭塞吗？”“没有旧心电图、还没有肌钙蛋白，你需要等吗？”“为什么这里不选溶栓？”“CT 报告的‘狭窄’能说明斑块此刻是否稳定吗？”“出现 QS 波以后还有心肌可救吗？”“大面积前壁梗死后，出院前还缺什么？”。可以讲解 ESC 2023 ACS、第四版心肌梗死通用定义（2018）和中国 STEMI 指南（2019）的相关原则；学员读到相应记录之后，可以指出记录病程（多次复查心电图、病历中有一份冠状动脉 CT、症状反复后才急诊造影）与现行做法的差别。不提前说出诊断或任何决策的正确选项；不补充病例中没有的资料（生命体征、查体、ST 段抬高幅度、标志物数值、各次心电图和冠状动脉 CT 的准确时间、超声心动图和远期结局都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Socratic preceptor (PEARLS) who asks only about information the learner already has, e.g. “Which way does RBBB itself push the ST segment and T wave in V1–V3?”, “Does a non-convex ST segment exclude an occluded artery?”, “No old ECG and no troponin yet — do you need to wait?”, “Why not fibrinolysis here?”, “Can a CT report of ‘stenosis’ tell you whether the plaque is stable right now?”, “Once QS waves appear, is anything left to save?”, “After a large anterior infarct, what is still missing before discharge?”. May explain the relevant principles of ESC 2023 ACS, the Fourth Universal Definition of MI (2018) and the Chinese STEMI guideline (2019), and — once the learner has read the records — contrast the recorded course (repeated ECGs, a coronary CT in his record, emergency angiography only after the pain recurred) with current practice. Never states the diagnosis or any decision's correct option before the learner commits, and adds no data the case lacks (vital signs, examination, ST amplitudes, marker values, the exact times of the tracings and of the CT, echocardiography and the long-term outcome are not recorded).

name.zh-CN: 靳医生（心内科介入医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 介入心内科医生，接到导管室呼叫后参与。只解读学员已经读过的心电图、冠状动脉 CT 和心导管室记录：解释 RBBB 背景下原发与继发 ST–T 改变的区别、前壁导联与前降支近段的对应关系、为什么 CT 的狭窄分级不能代替有创造影、罪犯病变 PCI 后非罪犯血管的评估，以及 PCI 后的双联抗血小板。不报告学员尚未读到的结果；不编造 TIMI 血流、支架类型、回旋支的造影所见、术中所见或并发症（都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Interventional cardiologist who joins once the catheter laboratory is called. Interprets only the ECGs, coronary CT and catheter laboratory record the learner has read: primary versus secondary ST–T change in RBBB, how the anterior leads map to the proximal LAD, why a CT stenosis grade cannot stand in for invasive angiography, how non-culprit vessels are assessed after culprit PCI, and dual antiplatelet therapy after PCI. Never reports a result the learner has not read, and never invents TIMI flow, stent type, circumflex findings at angiography, procedural findings or complications (none is recorded).

title.zh-CN: 复盘：右束支传导阻滞背景下的胸痛心电图与再灌注时机
title.en: Debrief: chest-pain ECGs in right bundle branch block and the timing of reperfusion

conclusion.zh-CN: 68岁男性，胸痛 5 小时仍未缓解，伴胸闷。首份心电图为右束支传导阻滞，V2–V3 导联 ST 段抬高（非弓背向上）伴直立 T 波——阻滞解释不了的原发性改变——V4–V6 导联呈 Rs 型。记录病程中多次复查心电图：2 小时后 V1–V3 导联 ST 段抬高、V2 导联 T 波倒置，此后 V4 导联呈 QS 型，V2–V3 与 V5–V6 导联 R 波降低；cTnT 和 CK-MB 明显升高；冠状动脉 CT 报告前降支近段中重度狭窄。胸痛反复后急诊造影见前降支近段次全闭塞，置入支架；1 周后心电图仍为 RBBB，V2–V4 导联呈 QS 型，为广泛梗死图形。诊断：前降支近段罪犯病变所致、表现为 RBBB 背景下 ST 段抬高的急性前壁心肌梗死。按现行指南（ESC 2023 ACS），应在首份心电图后立即造影行直接 PCI，而不是先做 CT、等待肌钙蛋白或等症状再发。1 周以后的情况没有记录。
conclusion.en: A 68-year-old man presented with five hours of unrelieved chest pain and chest tightness. His first ECG showed RBBB with non-convex ST elevation and upright T waves in V2–V3 — a primary change the block cannot explain — and Rs complexes in V4–V6. In the recorded course the ECG was repeated: at 2 hours, ST elevation in V1–V3 with T-wave inversion in V2; later QS in V4 and falling R waves in V2–V3 and V5–V6. Troponin T and CK-MB were markedly raised; a coronary CT reported moderate-to-severe proximal LAD stenosis. After the pain recurred, emergency angiography found a subtotal proximal LAD occlusion, which was stented; a week later the ECG still showed RBBB with QS in V2–V4, an extensive infarction pattern. Diagnosis: acute anterior myocardial infarction from a proximal LAD culprit, presenting as ST elevation in RBBB. Today's answer (ESC 2023 ACS): immediate angiography and primary PCI on the first tracing — not a CT, a troponin wait or a recurrence. Nothing later is recorded.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 68岁男性胸痛 5 小时仍未缓解，首先要排除急性冠脉闭塞；第一项检查是几分钟内完成的心电图。
keyReasoning.en: Five hours of unrelieved chest pain in a 68-year-old man puts acute coronary occlusion first; the first test is an ECG within minutes.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: RBBB 预期的是 V1–V3 导联 ST 段压低、T 波倒置；V2–V3 导联 ST 段抬高伴直立 T 波与阻滞自身的图形相反，因此提示原发性损伤。
keyReasoning.en: RBBB predicts ST depression and inverted T waves in V1–V3; ST elevation with upright T waves in V2–V3 contradicts the block's own pattern and so signals primary injury.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 胸痛仍在时，这一图形就足以决定立即造影：没有旧心电图、肌钙蛋白未出、ST 段不呈弓背向上，都不改变决定。
keyReasoning.en: With the pain still present, that pattern is enough for immediate angiography: the missing old tracing, the pending troponin and the non-convex shape change nothing in the decision.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 之后的心电图（ST 段抬高扩展到 V1–V3、V2 导联 T 波倒置、V4 导联 QS 型、V2–V3 与 V5–V6 导联 R 波降低）和明显升高的标志物证实前壁梗死在进展；CT 的狭窄分级不能把它降级。
keyReasoning.en: The later tracings (ST elevation spreading to V1–V3, T inversion in V2, QS in V4, falling R waves in V2–V3 and V5–V6) and markedly raised markers confirm an evolving anterior infarct; a CT stenosis grade does not downgrade it.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 前降支近段罪犯病变置入支架后，梗死范围（V2–V4 导联 QS 型）把重点转向左心室功能、二级预防和心律失常风险评估的时机，而不是为束支阻滞植入起搏器。
keyReasoning.en: Once the proximal LAD culprit is stented, the size of the infarct (QS in V2–V4) turns attention to LV function, secondary prevention and the timing of rhythm-risk assessment — not to pacing for the bundle branch block.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单篇病例报告，本版依据 1.0.0 版提取的事实改写，尚未对照原文全文核对。它不能说明延误造成了多少心肌损失，也不能证明更早造影会改变结局。病例没有记录生命体征、查体、ST 段抬高幅度、标志物数值、各次心电图的准确时间、超声心动图和 1 周以后的情况；决策、处置选项和评分是教学设计，不改变记录的病程。
boundaries.en: A single case report, re-authored here from the facts extracted for version 1.0.0 and not yet checked against the full article. It cannot show how much myocardium the delay cost, or that earlier angiography would have changed the result. No vital signs, examination, ST amplitudes, marker values, exact ECG times, echocardiogram or follow-up beyond one week are recorded; the decisions, intervention options and scoring are teaching design and do not change the recorded course.

unknowns.zh-CN: 各阶段的生命体征和查体结果。
unknowns.en: Vital signs and examination findings at any point.

unknowns.zh-CN: 心电图的测量值（心率、节律、QRS 时限、各导联 ST 段抬高幅度）、首份及之后各次心电图的准确时间，以及有没有可对比的既往心电图（RBBB 是否新发）。
unknowns.en: ECG measurements (rate, rhythm, QRS duration, ST amplitude in each lead), the exact times of the first and the later tracings, and whether an earlier ECG existed (whether the RBBB was new).

unknowns.zh-CN: cTnT 和 CK-MB 的数值、单位、参考区间和采血时间。
unknowns.en: Troponin T and CK-MB values, units, reference ranges and sampling times.

unknowns.zh-CN: 冠状动脉 CT 是什么时候做的（是否在本次住院期间，与各次心电图和症状反复的先后），以及从到院到急诊造影隔了多久。
unknowns.en: When the coronary CT was done (whether during this admission, and relative to the tracings and to the recurrence of pain), and how long passed from arrival to the emergency angiogram.

unknowns.zh-CN: 造影和介入细节：TIMI 血流、支架类型和数量、回旋支病变的造影所见、术中及术前用药与剂量、并发症。
unknowns.en: Angiographic and procedural detail: TIMI flow, stent type and number, the circumflex lesion at angiography, the drugs and doses given before and during PCI, and complications.

unknowns.zh-CN: 既往史、危险因素（高血压、糖尿病、血脂、吸烟、家族史）、长期用药、过敏史和出血史。
unknowns.en: Past history, risk factors (hypertension, diabetes, lipids, smoking, family history), regular medicines, allergies and bleeding history.

unknowns.zh-CN: 左心室功能（超声心动图）、住院期间并发症、出院用药、随访和远期结局。
unknowns.en: Left-ventricular function (echocardiography), in-hospital complications, discharge medicines, follow-up and the long-term outcome.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: RBBB 时照样读 ST 段。阻滞本身的复极方向与终末 R′ 相反——V1–V3 导联 ST 段压低、T 波倒置——所以这些导联出现 ST 段抬高伴直立 T 波就是原发性损伤图形，与 ST 段形态无关；早期前壁梗死的 ST 段常呈直线或凹面向上。第四版心肌梗死通用定义（ESC/ACC/AHA/WHF 2018）把 RBBB 患者新出现的 ST 段抬高或 Q 波视为缺血或梗死的线索。记录与现行做法：记录中的团队用数小时反复复查心电图；按现行做法，持续胸痛加上首份心电图已足以行动。
teachingPoints.en: Read the ST segment in RBBB. The block's own repolarisation runs against the terminal R′ — ST depression and T-wave inversion in V1–V3 — so ST elevation with upright T waves there is a primary injury pattern whatever its shape; early anterior infarction often has straight or concave ST elevation. The Fourth Universal Definition of MI (ESC/ACC/AHA/WHF 2018) treats new ST elevation or Q waves in RBBB as signs of ischaemia or infarction. Then and now: the recorded team repeated the ECG over hours; today ongoing pain plus the first tracing is enough to act.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 按首份心电图行动。ESC 2023 ACS：首次医疗接触后 10 分钟内完成心电图；立即持续心电监护并具备除颤条件；持续缺血症状合并束支阻滞按直接 PCI 策略处理，能在诊断后 120 分钟内完成 PCI 时优于溶栓；阿司匹林 150–300 mg 口服负荷，PCI 时普通肝素 70–100 U/kg。肌钙蛋白、旧心电图和 CT 都不是启动的前提。中国 STEMI 指南（2019）同样要求 10 分钟内完成心电图并给予阿司匹林负荷。
teachingPoints.en: Act on the first ECG. ESC 2023 ACS: an ECG within 10 minutes of first medical contact; continuous ECG monitoring with a defibrillator at once; a primary PCI strategy for ongoing ischaemic symptoms with bundle branch block, preferred to fibrinolysis whenever PCI can be done within 120 minutes of diagnosis; aspirin 150–300 mg orally and unfractionated heparin 70–100 U/kg at PCI. Troponin, an old ECG and a CT do not gate the decision. The Chinese STEMI guideline (2019) sets the same 10-minute ECG and aspirin loading.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 反复胸痛伴动态 ST 段改变属于极高危：即使把心电图理解为非 ST 段抬高 ACS，ESC 2023 ACS 也要求 2 小时内立即侵入策略。冠状动脉 CT 血管成像属于谱系的另一端——肌钙蛋白和心电图正常或不确定、胸痛不再发作的疑似 ACS（ESC 2023 ACS）。记录与现行做法：这位患者的病历中有一份冠状动脉 CT（前降支近段“中重度”狭窄，做 CT 的时间没有记录），他在胸痛反复后才进导管室，造影见同一节段次全闭塞。
teachingPoints.en: Recurrent pain with dynamic ST changes is very high risk: even if the tracing is read as NSTE-ACS, ESC 2023 ACS calls for an immediate invasive strategy within 2 hours. CT coronary angiography belongs at the other end of the spectrum — suspected ACS with normal or inconclusive troponin and ECG and no recurrent pain (ESC 2023 ACS). Then and now: this patient's record holds a coronary CT ('moderate-to-severe' proximal LAD stenosis; when it was done is not recorded), and he reached the catheter laboratory only after the pain recurred; the angiogram showed a subtotal occlusion of that same segment.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 演变不等于缓解。ST 段抬高扩展到 V1、ST 段仍抬高时出现的 T 波倒置、V4 导联新的 QS 型和 R 波降低，提示梗死在进展，而不是自发再通；Q 波代表已有坏死，不代表已无可挽救的心肌。ESC 2023 ACS 对缺血症状持续或反复的患者，即使超过 12 小时也推荐直接 PCI 策略。
teachingPoints.en: Evolution is not resolution. ST elevation spreading to V1, T-wave inversion while the ST segment stays raised, a new QS complex in V4 and falling R waves mark an infarct in progress, not spontaneous reperfusion; Q waves mark necrosis, not the absence of salvageable muscle. ESC 2023 ACS recommends a primary PCI strategy even beyond 12 hours whenever ischaemic symptoms persist or recur.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 大面积前壁梗死伴持续 RBBB 之后：住院期间行超声心动图评估射血分数、室壁运动和左心室血栓；阿司匹林 75–100 mg 加替格瑞洛 90 mg 每日两次或普拉格雷 10 mg 每日一次，共 12 个月（出血风险高时调整）；高强度他汀，LDL-C < 1.4 mmol/L 且下降 ≥ 50%；心脏康复（ESC 2023 ACS）。中国血脂管理指南（2023 年）按危险分层定目标——极高危 < 1.8 mmol/L，超高危 < 1.4 mmol/L——他的危险因素没有记录，无法分层。单纯 RBBB 不伴房室传导阻滞或晕厥不是起搏指征（ESC 2021 起搏指南）；一级预防 ICD 要等梗死后 6–12 周复查射血分数再定（ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南）。
teachingPoints.en: After a large anterior infarct with persisting RBBB: echocardiography during the admission for LVEF, wall motion and LV thrombus; aspirin 75–100 mg plus ticagrelor 90 mg twice daily or prasugrel 10 mg daily for 12 months, adjusted if bleeding risk is high; a high-intensity statin to LDL-C below 1.4 mmol/L with a fall of at least 50 %; cardiac rehabilitation (ESC 2023 ACS). The Chinese lipid guideline (2023) sets its targets by risk tier — below 1.8 mmol/L for very high risk, below 1.4 mmol/L for ultra-high risk — and his tier cannot be set because his risk factors are not recorded. Isolated RBBB without AV block or syncope is not a pacing indication (ESC 2021 pacing), and a primary-prevention ICD waits for LVEF re-assessment 6–12 weeks after the infarct (ESC 2022 ventricular arrhythmias).

notice.zh-CN: 教学脚本评估，并非经过验证的能力评分。
notice.en: A teaching-script measure, not a validated competency score.

unknowns.zh-CN: 各阶段的生命体征和查体结果。
unknowns.en: Vital signs and examination findings at any point.

unknowns.zh-CN: 心电图的测量值（心率、节律、QRS 时限、各导联 ST 段抬高幅度）、首份及之后各次心电图的准确时间，以及有没有可对比的既往心电图（RBBB 是否新发）。
unknowns.en: ECG measurements (rate, rhythm, QRS duration, ST amplitude in each lead), the exact times of the first and the later tracings, and whether an earlier ECG existed (whether the RBBB was new).

unknowns.zh-CN: cTnT 和 CK-MB 的数值、单位、参考区间和采血时间。
unknowns.en: Troponin T and CK-MB values, units, reference ranges and sampling times.

unknowns.zh-CN: 冠状动脉 CT 是什么时候做的（是否在本次住院期间，与各次心电图和症状反复的先后），以及从到院到急诊造影隔了多久。
unknowns.en: When the coronary CT was done (whether during this admission, and relative to the tracings and to the recurrence of pain), and how long passed from arrival to the emergency angiogram.

unknowns.zh-CN: 造影和介入细节：TIMI 血流、支架类型和数量、回旋支病变的造影所见、术中及术前用药与剂量、并发症。
unknowns.en: Angiographic and procedural detail: TIMI flow, stent type and number, the circumflex lesion at angiography, the drugs and doses given before and during PCI, and complications.

unknowns.zh-CN: 既往史、危险因素（高血压、糖尿病、血脂、吸烟、家族史）、长期用药、过敏史和出血史。
unknowns.en: Past history, risk factors (hypertension, diabetes, lipids, smoking, family history), regular medicines, allergies and bleeding history.

unknowns.zh-CN: 左心室功能（超声心动图）、住院期间并发症、出院用药、随访和远期结局。
unknowns.en: Left-ventricular function (echocardiography), in-hospital complications, discharge medicines, follow-up and the long-term outcome.
